title: Prompt Injection Guard
noData: Save prompts in .workpilot/prompts/, then run the analysis.

errors.noProject: Select a project to run the Injection Guard scan.

description: Checks every tool result an agent reads during a task (files, pages, commands, MCP answers), and the prompts saved in .workpilot/prompts/, for injection attempts.

toolResults.title: Flagged tool results
toolResults.description: Every result an agent reads is scanned before it reaches the model. A suspect one is passed on fenced, behind a warning; with WORKPILOT_TOOL_RESULT_GUARD=block a blocked one is withheld. Only where it came from is kept, never its content.
toolResults.empty: No tool result flagged in this project's tasks.

trusted.title: Trusted sources
trusted.description: A result from a source listed here is passed on unscanned, for example your test fixtures that contain injection samples. Agents cannot change this list. Wildcards * and ? are allowed, but * alone is refused.
trusted.empty: No trusted source: every result is scanned.
trusted.invalid: This entry is not valid and was not saved.
